llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it says: it scrapes public Korean government pages and appends parsed records to JSONL files. Before installing/running: 1) review the bundled scripts (you already have them) and run them in an isolated environment or container if you are cautious; 2) supply a dedicated output directory to avoid mixing with other files; 3) be aware it will make repeated network requests (throttled 0.8s) — check target sites' terms-of-service and robots.txt and avoid heavy scraping; 4) note the optional GOV_SCRAPER_UA environment variable (not documented in metadata) you can set to customize User-Agent; 5) if you need JS-rendered sources, this skill explicitly skips them and would require a separate Selenium/Playwright collector. Overall the package is coherent and does not request unexplained secrets or installs.
